summary: Claude Code Bash spawns fresh shell each call; ppid unreliable for session ID
trigger: Owner lease commands conflict because ppid changes between Bash invocations
lesson: Always set KOALA_SESSION_ID explicitly or use CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID anchor; never rely on ppid for session continuity
reusePrompt: owner lease session ID ppid instability Claude Code

summary: Story owner lease uses process-coordination IDs; fail-closed on non-owner writes
trigger: Agent hits story-owned-by-another-session error or needs to take over a stale or active lease
lesson: Use --takeover for stale leases (>30 min), --forceTakeover for active lease override; lease is process-coordination not crypto identity
reusePrompt: owner lease takeover forceTakeover stale active session

summary: DONE audit runs inside main write lock; reentrant lock without registry causes deadlock
trigger: DONE flow hangs or deadlocks during audit execution inside the same lock
lesson: Use in-process held-lock registry with same-root pass-through for reentrancy; never block on a lock you already hold
reusePrompt: main write lock reentrancy deadlock DONE audit

summary: packages/utils imports packages/main/dist; must build main before running recursive tsc
trigger: Recursive tsc fails with module-not-found in packages/utils even when packages/main source is clean
lesson: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build before recursive tsc; packages/utils depends on compiled dist output, not source
reusePrompt: recursive tsc module-not-found packages/utils packages/main build order

summary: Pre-push hook must fail-closed (exit 1) when node binary is absent, not fail-open
trigger: node is missing from PATH when git push runs; hook cannot identify koala self-hosting repo
lesson: Design gate hooks to fail-closed on missing dependencies: exit 1 with warning rather than exit 0 to avoid silently bypassing the gate
reusePrompt: pre-push hook fail-closed fail-open node missing dependency gate design

summary: init_check_repair requires acknowledge:true and fallbackReason≥30 chars; omitting either is rejected
trigger: CI or no-subagent environment cannot spawn INIT reviewer; story stuck at [missing_init_check]
lesson: Use koala init_check_repair with acknowledge:true and a ≥30-char fallbackReason; @fallback suffix in agentResults is mechanically distinguishable from independent reviewer
reusePrompt: init_check_repair CI no-subagent acknowledge fallbackReason missing_init_check

summary: Shallow natural-language evidence or echo-done commands cannot pass strict verification gates
trigger: Story fails TEST or DONE gate because evidence consists of weak claims or self-verification without real output
lesson: Strict workflow profiles require real-machine test transcripts, integration test output, or docs_check evidence; prompt-only and echo-done claims are rejected
reusePrompt: verification evidence quality shallow strict gate weak claims prompt-only

summary: Reviewer calling finding_add with pass-only body is auto-normalized to review_pass_set
trigger: Reviewer reports no-findings or PASS via finding_add and it gets classified as an open finding
lesson: flow-policy:pass-only-normalization auto-converts low-severity koala-review-* finding_add with no failure language to review_pass_set; pass-only finding_add will not appear in open findings list
reusePrompt: reviewer pass-only finding_add normalized review_pass_set no-findings normalization

summary: Reviewers must call review_run_start first; findings or passes without reviewRunId are rejected
trigger: Reviewer submits finding_add or review_pass_set but it is not accepted as valid evidence for current review round
lesson: Always call review_run_start at the start of a review lane; include returned reviewRunId in finding_add and review_pass_set; retrofitting a run id onto legacy-signed records is rejected
reusePrompt: reviewer review_run_start reviewRunId finding_add review_pass_set binding lane

summary: Use story_review_dismiss to remove false-positive riskSignal elevation and restore original priority
trigger: story_create auto-elevates story to high priority because description mentions risky keyword that the story does not actually modify
lesson: When auto-elevation is a false positive, run koala story_review_dismiss with the category and ≥5-char reason; after all auto-elevated signals are dismissed priority rolls back and high-risk gates are lifted
reusePrompt: riskSignal dismiss false-positive auto-elevated priority rollback story_review_dismiss

summary: Two individually-correct framework stories combined post-merge to produce critical DONE gate bypass
trigger: Multiple framework stories touching gate policy, dirty classification, or artifact declaration are merged to main without a combination review
lesson: After merging parallel framework stories to main, do a combination review covering gate policy table, dirty-file classification ordering, command-entry gate guards, and DONE merge semantics; single-story reviews cannot detect cross-story interactions
reusePrompt: cross-story gate bypass combination review framework parallel merge incident
